pages.text: “Born by the sea, standing strong against the wind, exuding a gentle fragrance that calms the mind.”$(br2)Oxeye Daisy Tea is a mild yet powerful beverage made from dried oxeye daisy petals. The tea is clear with a faint herbal aroma. Drinking it grants a temporary Resistance boost, making the traveler more resilient to damage.

$(br2)$(br)Oxeye Daisy Tea is simple to prepare—$(br)blend dried oxeye daisy petals with sugar to create this protective tea.$(br)It is best consumed before battles or in hazardous environments to enhance personal defense.

Upon drinking Oxeye Daisy Tea, travelers gain a temporary Resistance boost, reducing incoming damage.$(br)This tea is a calming and protective drink, ideal for preparation before dangerous journeys.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
